patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width immersive imagery with text overlays and structured content blocks, often using a 4-column grid for product displays and a 2-column layout for feature highlights.

A distinctive, elegant serif display font is used for prominent section headings, creating a luxurious feel, while clean sans-serif fonts are used for body text and product details to maintain readability.

The primary color palette relies on a clean contrast between light backgrounds (white and a subtle light grey) and deep, almost black text, punctuated by a vibrant teal/light blue accent for calls to action and key brand elements.

The site features a multi-layered sticky header (top announcement bar and main navigation). As the user scrolls, content sections reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide effect, while large background images in some sections remain fixed or parallax gently, allowing text and other elements to scroll over them.

Product listing sections are organized into clear, consistent cards featuring product image, name, price, star rating, and a direct 'Add to Cart' or 'Choose Options' button, maintaining a uniform presentation.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation system (likely `locomotive-scroll` or similar), where elements fade up and slide into view as they enter the viewport. The main navigation and a top announcement bar remain sticky at the top of the page. Some full-width image sections utilize a fixed background effect, creating a parallax-like illusion as foreground content scrolls over them.
Interactive product cards feature a consistent layout with an image, text details, and a call-to-action, often presented in a responsive grid that adapts to different screen sizes.
Hero sections and key feature blocks integrate large, high-quality lifestyle photography with product imagery, often using subtle overlays to ensure text legibility.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) are used for section titles, providing a strong visual hierarchy against clean, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and some image containers, but overall the design maintains sharp, clean edges for layout elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and around prominent headings, creating a sense of openness and luxury. Product grids maintain a comfortable density with consistent padding.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated blend of a unique, elegant serif display font for major headings with clean sans-serif body text, creating a high-end editorial feel. This is paired with immersive, aspirational lifestyle photography and a vibrant teal accent color that injects a modern, fresh energy into the otherwise neutral palette.
